paite: Abib kha tang unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina ding in zang un. Abib kha in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un Aigupta gam a pan zan a ahon pikhiak.
heading: Paikan Kut / (Eks 12.1-20)

paite: TOUPA'N amin omna mun dia aseh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah na belamhon lak ua leh na ganhon lak ua Paikan Ankuang ding in na kithoih ding uh ahi.

Tanghou silngou soh toh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na damsung teng ua Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni uh na theihgigena ding un ni sagih tanghou silngou soh louh, haksatna tanghou toh na nek ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a pan kintak a pawtkhia na hi uhi.
Na gamsung uah ni sagih sung, na lak uah silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Ani khat ni nitaklam a na kithoihna sa uh zankhua in azingsang tan in bangmah a-om ding ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na omna uh koi lai mah ah Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih thei kei ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna mun dia aseh ding kia ah ahi ding. Huai ah Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt hun bang un nitaklam in Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih ding uhi.
Na em ding ua, TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah na ne ding ua, zingsang in na pai nawn ding ua, na puanin uah na lut ding uhi.
Ni guk sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh ahi. Ani sagih ni pen TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna na sem ding uh ahi kei hi.
Nipikal sagih na sim ding ua; na buhlak tung ua kipan nipikal sagih na sim ding uhi.
heading: Pawltak Kut / (Eks 34.22; Lev 23.15-21)

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl bang zel in na sepkhiak uh lak a noumau ut thu a thillat lan in TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Nipikal Ankuanglui na nei ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding ah na sikhanute uh, na tenna ua om Levite, na lak ua om gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Hiai dante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh ahi.
Na buhphual ua kipan leh na uain sukna khuk ua kipan na sekkhawm khit un ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuanglui na nei ding uhi.
heading: Biakbuk Ankuangluina / (Lev 23.33-43)

paite: Na ankuangluina uah nou toh, na tapa uh toh, na tanu uh toh, na sikhanu uh toh, na tenna ua om Levite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh kipaktak in na om ding uhi.

TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in ni sagih ankuang na lui ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un thil tung tengteng ah leh na khut ngakna tengteng uah ahon vualzawl dia, na vek un kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.

Kum teng in na pasal tengteng uh thumvei TOUPA ma ah mun hon sehsak ding ah akilang ding uh ahi. Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang ah, Nipikal Ankuang ah, Biakbuk Ankuang ah akilang ding ua, TOUPA ma ah kuamah khutvuak in na kilang ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un vualzawlna ahon muhsak bang zel in michih in azoh hun bang in ape ding ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak kulh kongpi tengteng ah na nam bang zel un vaihawmte leh heutute na kibawl chiat ding ua, mipite vai hoihtak in ahawmsak ding uh ahi.
heading: Dik A Vaihawmna

paite: Dik loutak in vai na hawm ding uh ahi kei. Kuamah deihsak tuam na nei ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna na la ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna in mipilte mit atawsak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam dam a na luahtheihna ding un adik kia na zui ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam na bawl chiang un apang ah sing bangchi mah in leng Asher na phutkhe ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un amuhdah lam suang leng na phut ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
